<?php
/**
 * ResourcePool - Manages shared resource handles for the Kubernetes sidecar proxy
 * Used by the ingress controller to manage upstream connection pooling
 * 
 * Deployed via Helm chart: templates/deployment.yaml
 * ConfigMap: resource-pool-config
 */

class ResourceHandle {
    private $ptr;
    private $pool;
    private $released = false;
    
    public function __construct($ptr, ResourcePool $pool) {
        $this->ptr = $ptr;
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }
    
    public function getPtr() {
        return $this->ptr;
    }
    
    public function release(): void {
        if (!$this->released) {
            $this->released = true;
            $this->pool->returnHandle($this);
        }
    }
    
    public function isReleased(): bool {
        return $this->released;
    }
    
    public function __destruct() {
        $this->release();
    }
}

class ResourcePool {
    private array $available = [];
    private array $inUse = [];
    private int $maxSize;
    private string $namespace;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxSize, string $namespace) {
        $this->maxSize = $maxSize;
        $this->namespace = $namespace;
    }
    
    public function acquire(): ?ResourceHandle {
        if (!empty($this->available)) {
            $ptr = array_pop($this->available);
            $handle = new ResourceHandle($ptr, $this);
            $this->inUse[spl_object_id($handle)] = $handle;
            return $handle;
        }
        
        if (count($this->inUse) < $this->maxSize) {
            $ptr = $this->allocateResource();
            $handle = new ResourceHandle($ptr, $this);
            $this->inUse[spl_object_id($handle)] = $handle;
            return $handle;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    public function returnHandle(ResourceHandle $handle): void {
        $id = spl_object_id($handle);
        if (isset($this->inUse[$id])) {
            unset($this->inUse[$id]);
            $this->available[] = $handle->getPtr();
        }
    }
    
    public function drainAndReallocate(): void {
        // Called during rolling update - drain connections gracefully
        // This is triggered by the preStop lifecycle hook in k8s
        foreach ($this->inUse as $id => $handle) {
            $handle->release();
        }
        
        // Reallocate fresh resources for the new pod generation
        $drained = $this->available;
        $this->available = [];
        
        foreach ($drained as $ptr) {
            $this->freeResource($ptr);
        }
    }
    
    private function allocateResource() {
        // In production this calls the sidecar via unix socket
        // Simulated here with ffi-like resource allocation
        return random_bytes(32);
    }
    
    private function freeResource($ptr): void {
        // Release back to the kernel buffer pool
        // In k8s this signals the sidecar to close the upstream conn
        sodium_memzero($ptr);
    }
    
    public function getStats(): array {
        return [
            'namespace' => $this->namespace,
            'available' => count($this->available),
            'in_use' => count($this->inUse),
            'max_size' => $this->maxSize,
        ];
    }
}

class ConnectionManager {
    private ResourcePool $pool;
    private array $pendingRequests = [];
    
    public function __construct(ResourcePool $pool) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(string $requestId, callable $handler): mixed {
        $handle = $this->pool->acquire();
        if ($handle === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Pool exhausted');
        }
        
        $this->pendingRequests[$requestId] = $handle;
        
        try {
            $result = $handler($handle->getPtr());
            return $result;
        } finally {
            $this->completeRequest($requestId);
        }
    }
    
    private function completeRequest(string $requestId): void {
        if (isset($this->pendingRequests[$requestId])) {
            $handle = $this->pendingRequests[$requestId];
            unset($this->pendingRequests[$requestId]);
            $handle->release();
        }
    }
    
    public function gracefulShutdown(): void {
        // SIGTERM handler for k8s pod termination
        // First drain the pool (releases all in-use handles)
        $this->pool->drainAndReallocate();
        
        // Then clean up any remaining pending requests
        foreach ($this->pendingRequests as $requestId => $handle) {
            $handle->release();
            unset($this->pendingRequests[$requestId]);
        }
    }
}

// Entry point - called from the PHP-FPM worker
$namespace = getenv('K8S_NAMESPACE') ?: 'default';
$poolSize = (int)(getenv('POOL_MAX_SIZE') ?: '32');

$pool = new ResourcePool($poolSize, $namespace);
$manager = new ConnectionManager($pool);

// Simulate request handling
try {
    $result = $manager->handleRequest('req-001', function($ptr) {
        // Process upstream response
        return strlen($ptr);
    });
    
    // Simulate graceful shutdown during request processing
    if (getenv('TERMINATING') === 'true') {
        $manager->gracefulShutdown();
    }
} catch (\Throwable $e) {
    error_log("[{$namespace}] Error: " . $e->getMessage());
}
